provision: The fleet gate template (.github/workflows/reusable-mutation-rust.yml) downloads the linux-x64 archive, verifies its digest and exports the path of the extracted binary as LIBRE_AI_CARGO_MUTANTS; tools/quality/check-mutation-rust.ts verifies that binary against this declaration (executable digest, then reported version) and never downloads or builds one. The release publishes no archive for darwin-arm64 or linux-arm64: those platforms are absent here and the gate refuses to run on them rather than accept a locally built binary. Archive digests were measured on the downloaded archives and are equal to the digests the release API reports for the same assets; executable digests were measured on the extracted binaries.
